newsitem.title: UK: U-Freight opens New Jersey operations centre.
newsitem.headline: U-Freight opens New Jersey operations centre.

text.p: U-Freight America has opened a freight terminal near Port Elizabeth in New Jersey to help its seafreight subsidiary, U-Ocean, to expand in the U.S. north east, the logistics group said in a press release.

Seafreight activities will move from New York and the new terminal offering storage capacity, bonded facilities and a distribution service across the U.S., will become U-Freight's centre for the publishing industry. The firm recently became a member of the Global Book Network - the specialist book shipping and logistics association.

"Moving books by sea is a huge business and offers the Network some exciting opportunities to develop its business with international publishers both in North America and in other international markets," said Gene Boyer, president of U-Freight America.
Frank T Hochgesand has been appointed divisional manager with a global brief to expand these new dedicated services for publishers, as well as other users of our seafreight services.

"As part of the Global Book Network, U-Freight America is able to take books straight from publishers and handle all their specific delivery requirements on a worldwide basis," added Boyer. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
